title: Earnings Preview: WesBanco (WSBC) Q3 Earnings Expected to Decline
author: Na
description: WesBanco is expected to report declining earnings despite revenue growth for Q3 2026, with an Earnings ESP of -0.61% and Zacks Rank #3 making an earnings beat unlikely. Hancock Whitney is projected to show stronger earnings growth of 10.7% year-over-year, but similarly faces a negative Earnings ESP of -0.20% despite its Zacks Rank #2 rating, making conclusive earnings beat predictions difficult for both banks.

title: Executive Sheds Over 3,000 Shares of Regional Bank, in Transaction Valued at More Than $125,000
author: Jake Lerch
description: Denise H. Knouse-Snyder, a Director at WesBanco, Inc., sold 3,070 shares on August 24, 2026, for approximately $125,532 at a weighted average price of $40.89 per share. This represents a 17% reduction in her direct holdings, leaving her with 15,035 shares. The sale captured a 24% gain over the 12-month period. WesBanco reported solid earnings and is trading near 52-week highs with strong revenue and net income, though the company faces some headwinds from softer net interest margins and an elevated loan-to-deposit ratio.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The insider sale is a neutral signal as such transactions are often routine wealth-management activities. While the company shows positive fundamentals with solid earnings, all-time high revenue and net income, and stock trading near 52-week highs, there are offsetting concerns including softer-than-expected net interest margins and an elevated loan-to-deposit ratio near 90% that could pressure margins going forward. The stock has also underperformed the S&P 500 over the past five years (7.6% CAGR vs. 12.9%).

title: WesBanco Declares Quarterly Cash Common and Preferred Stock Dividends
author: Prnewswire
description: WesBanco, Inc. (NASDAQ:WSBC) announced its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.38 per share for common stock holders, payable July 1, 2026, representing an annualized rate of $1.52 per share. The company also declared a quarterly dividend of $0.4609 per depositary share on its 7.375% Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series B (NASDAQ:WSBCO), also payable July 1, 2026.

title: WesBanco Declares Increase in Quarterly Cash Dividend to Its Shareholders
author: Prnewswire
description: WesBanco has increased its quarterly cash dividend by 2.7% to $0.38 per common share, payable on January 2, 2026. This marks the 19th dividend increase since 2010, representing a cumulative increase of 171%.

The 171% cumulative dividend increase since 2010 suggests sustained financial performance and shareholder value creation.
